Yes, use them. If your grip quits before your back does, the back isn't getting the work it should, and straps fix that. A simple rule is to go without straps on your warm-ups and lighter sets so your grip keeps training, then strap in for the heavy top sets and anything high-rep.

Your grip also improves on its own if you train it separately. Heavy holds, farmer carries, and a mixed or hook grip on the bar all help, and none of it needs to eat into your deadlift work.

The one exception is a lifting meet or a test that bans straps. In that case, build the grip work in so you aren't surprised on the day.
